notes: Prompt wraps mid-mixed-number in both modes: 'How many worms are 1 / 1/4 centimetres long?' splits '1 1/4' across the line break, so it can read as two separate numbers. A non-breaking space inside the mixed number would fix it.
Same mixed-number line break as line_plot_fractional: '...that are 2 / 1/2 inches?' splits '2 1/2' across lines in both modes.

The dots at 15 and 16 touch each other over ticks labelled only every 2, so they can be misread as a two-dot stack at one value -- and which value the 4th sorted dot sits on is exactly what the median answer depends on. Affects both modes; wider dot spacing or smaller markers would help.
